mapper.sql: k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(k.source_path), '') IS NOT NULL AND (k.chapter_id IS NULL OR kc.status = 'PUBLISHED') AND (k.resource_id IS NULL OR ( r.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND rc.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.source_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.version_label), '') IS NOT NULL ))
FROM knowledge_chunks k LEFT JOIN chapters kc ON kc.id = k.chapter_id LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = k.resource_id LEFT JOIN chapters rc ON rc.id = r.chapter_id
mapper.select: SELECT review_status AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM knowledge_chunks GROUP BY review_status ORDER BY review_status

SELECT CASE WHEN source_path LIKE 'textbook/%' THEN 'textbook' WHEN source_path LIKE 'courseware/%' THEN 'courseware' WHEN source_path LIKE 'dev-mock/%' THEN 'dev-mock' WHEN source_path LIKE 'admin/%' THEN 'admin' ELSE 'other' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM knowledge_chunks GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT k.id, k.chapter_id AS chapterId, k.title, k.source_path AS sourcePath, k.page_label AS pageLabel, k.review_status AS reviewStatus, k.license_scope AS licenseScope, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retrievable, CHAR_LENGTH(k.content) AS contentLength, k.created_at AS createdAt
ORDER BY k.created_at DESC, k.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT k.id, k.chapter_id AS chapterId, k.title, k.content, k.source_path AS sourcePath, k.page_label AS pageLabel, k.review_status AS reviewStatus, k.license_scope AS licenseScope, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retrievable, k.created_at AS createdAt
WHERE k.id = #{chunkId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunks (id, chapter_id, title, content, source_path, page_label, review_status, license_scope) VALUES (#{id}, #{chapterId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sourcePath}, #{pageLabel}, #{reviewStatus}, #{licenseScope})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE id = #{chapterId}
